# Wire-format literals of the 402 body the Worker (worker/src/types.ts, worker/src/middleware/spendGate.ts)
# sends when a spend cap is reached and the app must agree on byte for byte; worker/src/types.test.ts and
# worker/test/index.test.ts assert against it, and the app's error handling (#422) will read the same file.
# One entry per line: the key, a tab, then the value verbatim.
cap-type-daily	daily
cap-type-monthly	monthly
cap-scope-user	user
cap-scope-global	global
cap-error-user-daily	Daily spend cap reached
cap-error-user-monthly	Monthly spend cap reached
cap-error-global-daily	Service daily spend cap reached
cap-error-global-monthly	Service monthly spend cap reached
